thread:
Rae: Quick heads-up  the communal cookie jar on the middle shelf was left open and there are ants. Can someone check the top shelf too? :ant:
Ollie: Ack, saw crumbs last night. Ill take the jar, give it a wipe and put it in a sealed bin. Sorry folks.
Sunny: Maybe we should switch to clip-top jars and add a tiny sticker: "Shared snacks  close lid". Handwriting fades.
Harper: Clip-top sounds good. Also can we add a small "Contains nuts" sticker option? Some of the cookies are homemade.
Rae: YES on nut stickers. Also request: if you take the last of a shared item, please write EMPTY on the cap. Saves 2nd-person confusion.
Ollie: Ill drop two clip-top jars + a roll of clear labels tonight. Leaving a note by the sink how to print labels.
kitchen-bot: Reminder: "Kitchen quick tidy" Fridays @ 3pm. React :thumbsup: to join.
Sunny: Tiny poll: weekly snack run Friday morning? :one: yes :two: no
Rae: :one: (happy to host week 1)
Ollie: :one:
Harper: :two: (I prefer rotation signups)
Sunny: Looks like weekly wins but well do a signup rotation option, will post doc.
Rae: Thanks everyone. Also kudos to Ollie for rescuing the crumb avalanche. :tada:
